title: Board Background Deselect Without Preselect
description: When deselecting by clicking the board background, skip the preselect phase: no preselect_removed exit highlight flash while the pointer is down. Background click-only should commit selection directly.
summary: Highlight (selectionExit) is confined to the preselect phase only: GPU/JS use preselect_removed while is_preselecting, never selection_exit_highlight after commit or pick. commit_area_select_from_initial and all select events emit empty exitHighlightIds; JS ignores exitHighlightIds on select.
